summary: First-finish smoke test for CrediFlux (loan management app). Backend auth, clients CRUD, payments (register + undo), PATCH rebuild, DELETE, and dashboard all working. Frontend login (wrong+correct creds), dashboard load, add-client (À Vista), row rendering, status filter tabs, search, pay-btn payment dialog submit, and logout redirect all passed.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 with 'E-mail ou senha inválidos'
POST /api/auth/login with correct admin creds returns 200 and sets cookies
POST /api/clients à vista creates 1 installment, total_due = 1000 * 1.10 = 1100
POST /api/clients parcelado(3, mensal) creates 3 installments spaced monthly (Feb/Mar/Apr), amount 1100 each, total 3300
POST /api/clients/{id}/payments marks installment paid, decreases balance
PATCH /api/clients/{id} with installments_count=2 rebuilds to 2 installments
Login UI: wrong creds shows login-error 'E-mail ou senha inválidos'
Login UI: correct creds redirects to Dashboard (dashboard-title visible)
Add-client dialog opens, submits À Vista client, dialog closes, row appears
Status filter tabs (filter-atrasado, filter-todos) clickable and change filter
Search input filters clients by name
Pay button opens payment-dialog; pd-submit registers payment successfully
Header menu → logout clears session and redirects to /login
notes: Status computation observed: created clients with due_date in 2026-01/02 showed 'atrasado' — expected since server date is 2026-09-05 (past those dates). Client detail sheet (installments list + undo per-installment) and alerts banner were not exercised in UI due to time-box; backend for these flows is verified. Test data cleaned up after run.
